sections.template: Fill after obtaining the declared observations.

stages.instruction: Before subject work agree coarse Task phases with the independent reviewer. Identify audience/language/ownership, actual sources, content requirements and delivery target. Design only the imminent outline artifact: goal, required result, acceptance criteria, mapping/navigation, completeness and preservation. Keep later verification scope coarse; do not predesign detailed drafting or write document/product/test files.

sections.report: State current phase goal, result requirements, acceptance criteria, exact source/evidence identities, result, limitations and preservation. Reviews record independent substantiated findings and decisions.
sections.source_inventory: Identify actual sources of truth by revision/digest, coverage of factual claims and conflicting/stale sources. Preserve document ownership and source generation; resolve conflicts explicitly from their actual owner.
sections.content_requirements: For each requirement identify required information/example/instruction, actual source and DoD references, audience/language/ownership constraints and target section. Account for every required item.
sections.publication_target: State actual codebase/path or Task artifact destination, format, visibility and delivery/transport policy, including push restrictions and actual authority. Local drafting/validation is not external publication or user consent. Reuse actual authorization; do not invent approval loops.
sections.verification_scope: State coarse coverage and evidence classes for documentation accuracy, requirements, examples/commands, links and source identity. Do not design detailed future invocations before the accepted outline.
sections.outline_plan: State current outline goal, required structure/mapping, acceptance criteria, audience, language and ownership, actual source/content-requirement inputs, navigation/ordering and completeness checks. Do not write final document files.

stages.instruction: Independently review the imminent outline design and actual source/content/delivery context for executability, completeness and unambiguity. Check goal/result/acceptance, audience/language/ownership, source identity/conflicts and coverage; keep future verification scope coarse. Decide criteria only for outline artifact execution. Reject design to framing.

sections.report: State current phase goal, result requirements, acceptance criteria, exact source/evidence identities, result, limitations and preservation. Reviews record independent substantiated findings and decisions.

stages.instruction: Produce only the current outline Task artifact under accepted outline_plan. Map every content requirement/source to ordered sections, purposes and navigation, with the actual audience/language and ownership constraints. Preserve sources and unrelated files. Do not draft final documents or detailed future implementation plans before outline acceptance.

sections.report: State current phase goal, result requirements, acceptance criteria, exact source/evidence identities, result, limitations and preservation. Reviews record independent substantiated findings and decisions.
sections.outline: Publish section IDs, purposes, reader/navigation order and content-requirement/source mapping as the current Task outline artifact. Account for every required item and actual conflicting-source disposition.

stages.instruction: Independently verify the actual outline artifact against accepted outline_plan, source inventory, content requirements, audience/language/ownership and navigation/completeness criteria. Reject outline execution to outline; accept the real outline before detailed drafting planning.

sections.report: State current phase goal, result requirements, acceptance criteria, exact source/evidence identities, result, limitations and preservation. Reviews record independent substantiated findings and decisions.

stages.instruction: Only after independent acceptance of the actual outline, design imminent drafting and verification: goal, result requirements, acceptance criteria, exact owned docs paths, current source/outline identities, audience/language/ownership, factual content, requirement mapping, safe actual example/command checks, links and delivery policy. Do not write document files or invent future commands/hashes or new environments.

sections.report: State current phase goal, result requirements, acceptance criteria, exact source/evidence identities, result, limitations and preservation. Reviews record independent substantiated findings and decisions.
sections.drafting_plan: State current drafting goal, result requirements, acceptance criteria, accepted outline/source identities, exact owned docs paths, audience/language, content/command/link scope, requirement mapping, preservation and safe verification methods.
sections.verification_plan: Bind current drafting requirements/DoD to exact existing PlannedInvocation HR-054 or declared logical/inspection methods, before/after predicates, phase applicability, reuse/retry/limits and real source/document identity. Existing methods/inputs and safe authorized mutation bounds must be explicit. Runtime adds actual BoundExecution digests; never fabricate future commands/hashes or introduce unauthorized environments.

stages.instruction: Independently review current drafting/verification plans against accepted actual outline and sources for executability, completeness and unambiguity. Check all content requirements, audience/language/ownership, exact docs scope, factual/source identity, real safe methods/inputs, example outcomes, links and preservation. Decide only drafting execution criteria. Reject design to drafting_planning.

sections.report: State current phase goal, result requirements, acceptance criteria, exact source/evidence identities, result, limitations and preservation. Reviews record independent substantiated findings and decisions.

stages.instruction: Write only the independently accepted document deliverable within docs/** using accepted outline, current sources and drafting/verification plans. Follow the target repository audience/language/ownership rules and preserve unrelated prose, product code and tests. Publish actual content references/digests and requirement mapping without unnecessary full Git-document duplication in Task DB. Record real example/command locators and proof. Do not infer external publication, push or user consent from local drafting.

sections.report: State current phase goal, result requirements, acceptance criteria, exact source/evidence identities, result, limitations and preservation. Reviews record independent substantiated findings and decisions.
sections.content: Publish actual final document references/digests or required standalone Markdown content, with requirement-to-section mapping. Do not unnecessarily duplicate a complete Git document into Task DB. Bind the delivered current document and factual sources to actual revisions.
sections.examples_commands: For each example identify actual document locator, exact executable method and inputs, safe authorized mutation/environment bounds, expected outcome and actual verification receipts. A plausible command string or lint success alone is not proof of accuracy.

stages.instruction: Execute accepted exact checks against current document/source identity and all content requirements: factual accuracy, substantive completeness, actual safe authorized examples/commands and expected outcomes, links/navigation, audience/language and preservation. Publish actual validation.verdict and complete current receipts; a placeholder, stale success or lint alone is not proof. Satisfied proceeds to independent review; failure/inconclusive returns to drafting without reopening accepted design. Do not edit product/state or use unauthorized environments.

sections.report: State current phase goal, result requirements, acceptance criteria, exact source/evidence identities, result, limitations and preservation. Reviews record independent substantiated findings and decisions.

stages.instruction: Independently inspect the current final document/diff against accepted drafting/verification plans, outline, source identities and every content requirement. Require actual complete current-document/source-matched validation.verdict and evidence of substantive coverage, factual claims, safe examples/commands, links, audience/language/ownership, development rules and general result requirements; lint alone cannot pass. Reject execution to drafting within this same phase, never to accepted design. Record actual delivery/publication status and actual authority; do not edit documents or fabricate push, publication or user consent.

sections.report: State current phase goal, result requirements, acceptance criteria, exact source/evidence identities, result, limitations and preservation. Reviews record independent substantiated findings and decisions.
sections.result: Record actual final substantive document result, fulfilled/unfulfilled DoD/verdicts, source/current-document identities, coverage/example/link evidence, deliverables and actual delivery/publication status, limitations, incidents and outstanding obligations. Do not fabricate push, publication, user consent or waivers.
